neighbours.label: ' course' in the discourse phrase 'of course'
fire: She smiled and said, of course, that she would help us move.
The mayor, of course, denied every allegation in the report.
We had forgotten the tickets. Of course, the gate was already closed.
Well of course he wanted the bigger slice of cake.
The weather turned bad, and of course the bus was late.
There were, of course, a few complaints about the noise.
He lost his keys again. Of course, nobody was surprised.
You can, of course, cancel your order at any time.
quiet: She smiled and said that she would help us move on Sunday.
The mayor quickly denied every allegation in the report.
We had forgotten the tickets. Sadly, the gate was already closed.
Well, he clearly wanted the bigger slice of cake.
The weather turned bad, and the golf course was flooded.
There were a few complaints about the course schedule.
He lost his keys again during the cooking course.
You can cancel your order at any time before shipping.
